question.text:
Electrolysis is carried out in three cells

(A) $1.0 \mathrm{M} \mathrm{OuSO}_{4}$ Pt electrode

(B) $1.0 \mathrm{M} \mathrm{CuSO}_{4}$ copper electrodes

(C) $1.0 \mathrm{M} \mathrm{KCl}$ Pt electrodes If volume of electrolytic solution is maintained constant in each of the cell, which is correct set of pH changes in $(\mathrm{A}),(\mathrm{B})$ and $(\mathrm{C})$ cell respectively?
